pricingPage.faq1a: The prices shown are base estimates. Final pricing depends on feature complexity, number of pages, and integrations required. For system development, please reach out first so I can provide an accurate quote.
pricingPage.faq2q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricingPage.faq2a: Yes. There is no minimum contract period. Just give one month's notice and I'll cancel it. Unused dev hours are settled within the current month and do not carry over.
pricingPage.faq3q: Does the one-time plan include hosting?
pricingPage.faq3a: No, hosting is billed separately based on server specs (typically NT$300–800/month). You can pair it with a subscription maintenance plan if you'd like it handled together.
pricingPage.faq4q: Can I add a subscription plan after my site launches?
pricingPage.faq4a: Absolutely. Many clients complete a one-time website build first, then add a subscription plan once the site is stable. Both options are fully independent.
